title: Virtual configuration as a buffered configuration
statement: Let $L$ be a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols, and let $x,y$ be Boolean words. The virtual configuration formed from the initial configuration of $L$ on input $y$, with boundary tag true, virtual input-head position $1$ on input $x$, and empty output prefix, is the configuration on input $x$ whose state is the initial state of $L$ paired with true, and whose first work tape stores $y$ while every other work tape is blank.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
